name: Modules.Map.Snapshotter
summary: Snapshotter is used to allow screen shots to be taken of a specified region or a mapview.

examples.title: Taking a simple snapshot

properties.name: region
properties.summary: A dictionary specifying the location and zoom level of the map.

properties.name: showsBuildings
properties.summary:
Determines whether building will be shown on the map. The mapType property must be set 
to <Modules.Map.STANDARD_TYPE> for extruded buildings to be displayed.

properties.name: showsPointsOfInterest
properties.summary:
When this property is set to YES, the map displays icons and labels for 
restaurants, schools, and other relevant points of interest.

properties.name: size
properties.summary: A dictionary specifying the width and height of the snapshot.

inlined.name: SnapshotSize
inlined.summary: Simple dictionary used as an argument to [setSize](Modules.Map.Snapshotter.setSize).

properties.name: height
properties.summary: The height the be used for the snapshot.

properties.name: width
properties.summary: The height the be used for the snapshot.

methods.name: takeSnapshot
methods.summary:
Takes a snap shot of of the map corresponding to the region property or a snap of the mapView if
passed in as a second parameter.

parameters.name: success
parameters.summary: Function to be called upon successful completion.

parameters.name: error
parameters.summary: Function to call upon receiving an error.
